decision.title: The arena is part of the memory substrate
decision.summary: sxml_arena bump-allocates from caller memory and then from blocks of a block allocator, returns memory only on reset, finalize or destroy, and can bound its growth for untrusted input.

body.p: (task 0.5). sxml_arena in memory.h: bump allocation from caller initial_memory, then from blocks of block_byte_count taken from block_allocator; a request too large for a block gets a block of its own and the current block keeps serving small requests. The null allocator as block allocator gives a fixed-capacity arena (SXML_STATUS_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED); maximum_block_byte_count bounds growth for untrusted input (SXML_STATUS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, 0 = no bound). Memory goes back only on sxml_arena_reset, _finalize or _destroy; sxml_arena_as_allocator exposes it as an sxml_allocator whose release does nothing. Typed, index-addressed storage for trees and XDM values (task 0.7) builds on it rather than replacing it.
